title: SAM Everything Mode Mis-segmentation Proof
scientific_conclusion: Without medical-specific prompts, SAM Everything Mode (sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth) generates an average of 4.16 masks per brain MRI scan across 25 BRISC 2025 and 25 Dataset 1 (Navoneel) scans. 54.52% of all detected masks encompass massive non-tumor anatomical structures (largest mask spanning an average of 50.29% and up to 84.6% of the entire scan), capturing the cranial bone ring, meninges, ventricles, and healthy cerebral hemispheres. On the 18 tumor slices with pixel-level ground truth, 89.77% of generated masks lie predominantly outside the tumor on skull/normal parenchyma. This empirically confirms that a prior ViT localization branch is mandatory before invoking SAM/MedSAM.
